note: v56.92 — 오늘 screen review: futures cards, bp yields, 4 diverse news with earnings context, score previous-basis fallback, macro freshness fix (P1380-P1385).

p.title: Headline-only earnings news carries estimate/actual context
p.symptom: 'Micron beats on earnings…' showed no numbers — how much it beat was invisible — because article bodies are not retained (rights).
p.root_cause: The earnings calendar artifact stored only estimates and no consumer joined it to news headlines.
p.fix: fetch-earnings-calendar keeps Finnhub epsActual/revenueActual; src/domain/news/earnings-context.js matches a headline to a recent (<=3 days) report via the universe company name and renders '실적(9/30 장 마감 후) · EPS 35.10 (예상 32.56 대비 +7.8%) · 매출 …' (estimates only until actuals are published).
p.violated_rule: Missing values are never invented; the context is structured provider data, not inferred from the headline.
p.prevention: Module checked with estimate-only, actual and non-matching fixtures.
p.verification: Local browser: Micron item shows '실적(9/30 장 마감 후) · EPS 예상 32.56 · 매출 예상 $52.6B'; actuals appear after the next earnings producer run.
